shared_elements: stone monument with rounded/arched upper contour
low-relief carving on a single principal face
suggestion of a human figure or head
stone displayed on a museum mount/base
justification: Both are single-faced stone monuments with a rounded upper contour whose decorated surface is broken up by horizontal bands and includes disc-like circular motifs, and both show at least a schematic human presence. But A is a small, thin, flat slab covered in shallow, fine, evenly distributed incisions arranged in tidy registers of small figures and repetitive sign-like marks, while B is a massive, irregular boulder with deep, bold, sparse carving on a strongly three-dimensional volume — the manner of cutting, scale, and density of ornament are quite different.
